away.summary: The Chicago Blackhawks are entering their first season under new captain Connor Bedard, who is expected to miss the first month due to a shoulder injury. Frank Nazar is stepping into the No. 1 center role, playing with Patrick Kane and Roman Kantserov. The team is looking to end a six-year playoff drought with a young, energetic group.

home.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights are celebrating their 10th season in the NHL, having made a massive impact on Las Vegas and the NHL as a whole. They have made the playoffs eight times in nine seasons, including a Stanley Cup win in 2023. Connelly, the No. 19 pick in the 2024 NHL Draft, is expected to make his NHL debut.
